raw: Stryver sucked the end of a ruler for a little while, and then stood hitting a tune out of his teeth with it, which probably gave him the toothache.
He broke the awkward silence by saying:
“This is something new to me, Mr.
You deliberately advise me not to go up to Soho and offer myself--_my_self, Stryver of the King’s Bench bar?”
“Do you ask me for my advice, Mr.
Then I give it, and you have repeated it correctly.”
